collection_rules.incomplete_or_unusable_final_batch: Block confirmatory comparison, preserve all evidence and diagnose. Any changed environment/protocol needs a new version; a replacement run must be a complete declared batch, not cherry-picked trials
collection_rules.ordinary_controller_failure: Keep as label 0; never discard because unfavorable
collection_rules.unusable_attempt: Preserve invalid initialization, internal errors and numerical warnings as explicit nonlabels; no replacements or selective retries

control_sampling: Baseline, high-force anchor, two rotating one-command contrasts, both nonbaseline speeds and two rotating multi-command configurations; full 54-command pool per final-test family

bootstrap.interval: 95% percentile; descriptive, not multiplicity-adjusted superiority testing

evaluation.fit_policy: Training CV for tuning; validation for documented development; final pipelines fitted on v1 train only for this comparison
evaluation.scope: Classifier probability comparison on predeclared candidates; no claim of faster physical execution or globally optimal control
evaluation.undefined_metric: Report null with reason; do not invent zero or collect extra data to change support

final.property_sampling: Complete 3 scale x 4 family mass x 4 friction grid once per family
final.release: Inputs, seed and labels remain outside Git until models, predictions and final evaluation are frozen

label_rule.sampling_limit: Retain existing raw evidence; sampled traces alone cannot independently reconstruct unsaved contacts

pilot.property_sampling: Four fixed light/high-friction to heavy/low-friction corners; all family mass and friction levels and all three scales, not a representative prevalence sample

pose_sampling: Latin hypercube within each family/role; reject whole candidate pose designs only for predeclared proximity to historical/pilot matched-property poses, never outcomes
target_population: New poses and latent execution errors in the known five-family simulator domain; not unseen shapes or sim-to-real
